name: R17 the leftovers: the world read and the world write
author: irongete
description: The verification suite for the world row of refactor block R17. `:tR17-6` asserts, through the API itself and over a 10 s window, that a walking gob is at a different point half a second later while a standing one is not, that a terrain read over ground nobody has streamed answers nil without asking the loader for anything, that a place off explored ground is not durable and cannot be saved while the place under you round-trips through JSON, that a place keeps its durable form for every login, and that the wire refuses a button no mouse has and a modifier bitfield no keyboard sends before anything leaves.
